title: Functional analysis of a down-regulated transcription factor-SoxNeuroA gene involved in the acaricidal mechanism of scopoletin against spider mites.
authors: Zhou, Hong; Ning, Yeshuang; Jian, Yufan; Zhang, Miao; Klakong, Matthana; Guo, Fuyou; Shao, Qingyi; Li, Yanhong; Yang, Pinglong; Li, Zongquan; Yang, Liang; Li, Shili; Ding, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物源杀螨剂东莨菪内酯通过下调转录因子SoxNeuroA调控Orai1钙通道基因转录的杀螨机制，涉及TF-DNA结合位点鉴定与分子对接，但对象为螨虫非典型TF-DNA体系且方法以实验为主，AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Insight into the mode of action of plant-derived acaricides will help in the development of sustainable control strategies for mite pests. Scopoletin, a promising plant-derived bioactive compound, displays prominent acaricidal activity against Tetranychus cinnabarinus. The transcription factor SoxNeuroA plays a vital role in maintaining calcium ion (Ca(2+) ) homeostasis. Down-regulation of SoxNeuroA gene expression occurs in scopoletin-exposed mites, but the functional role of this gene remains unknown. RESULTS: A SoxNeuroA gene from T. cinnabarinus (TcSoxNeuroA) was first cloned and identified. Reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR), quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction (qPCR), and Western blotting assays all confirmed that the gene expression and protein levels of TcSoxNeuroA were significantly reduced under scopoletin exposure. Furthermore, RNA interference silencing of the weakly expressed SoxNeuroA gene significantly enhanced the susceptibility of mites to scopoletin, suggesting that the acaricidal mechanism of scopoletin was mediated by the weakly expressed SoxNeuroA gene. Additionally, yeast one-hybrid (Y1H) and dual-luciferase reporter assays revealed that TcSoxNeuroA was a repressor of Orai1 Ca(2+) channel gene transcription, and the key binding sequence was ATCAAAG (positions -361 to -368 of the Orai1 promoter). Importantly, site-directed mutagenesis and microscale thermophoresis assays further indicated that ASP185, ARG189, and LYS217, which were key predicted hydrogen-bonding sites in the molecular docking model, may be the vital binding sites for scopoletin in TcSoxNeuroA. CONCLUSION: These results demonstrate that the acaricidal mechanism of scopoletin involves inhibition of the transcription factor SoxNeuroA, thus inducing the activation of the Orai1 Ca(2+) channel, eventually leading to Ca(2+) overload and lethality. Elucidation of the transcription factor-targeted mechanism for this potent plant-derived acaricide has vital implications for the design of next-generation green acaricides with novel targets. abstract_zh: 背景：深入了解植物源杀螨剂的作用模式将有助于制定可持续的螨类害虫防治策略。东莨菪内酯（scopoletin）是一种有前景的植物源生物活性化合物，对朱砂叶螨（Tetranychus cinnabarinus）表现出显著的杀螨活性。转录因子SoxNeuroA在维持钙离子（Ca(2+)）稳态中发挥关键作用。在东莨菪内酯暴露的螨类中，SoxNeuroA基因表达下调，但该基因的功能作用仍不清楚。结果：首先克隆并鉴定了来自朱砂叶螨的SoxNeuroA基因（TcSoxNeuroA）。逆转录聚合酶链反应（RT-PCR）、实时定量聚合酶链反应（qPCR）和Western blotting分析均证实，在东莨菪内酯暴露下，TcSoxNeuroA的基因表达和蛋白水平显著降低。此外，对弱表达的SoxNeuroA基因进行RNA干扰沉默，显著增强了螨类对东莨菪内酯的敏感性，表明东莨菪内酯的杀螨机制是由弱表达的SoxNeuroA基因介导的。另外，酵母单杂交（Y1H）和双荧光素酶报告基因实验揭示，TcSoxNeuroA是Orai1 Ca(2+)通道基因转录的抑制因子，关键结合序列为ATCAAAG（位于Orai1启动子-361至-368位点）。重要的是，定点突变和微量热泳动实验进一步表明，分子对接模型中预测的关键氢键位点ASP185、ARG189和LYS217可能是东莨菪内酯在TcSoxNeuroA中的关键结合位点。结论：这些结果表明，东莨菪内酯的杀螨机制涉及抑制转录因子SoxNeuroA，从而诱导Orai1 Ca(2+)通道的激活，最终导致Ca(2+)超载和致死。阐明这种强效植物源杀螨剂的转录因子靶向机制，对设计具有新靶点的下一代绿色杀螨剂具有重要意义。(c) 2023 化学工业学会。
